ValidationRule.description: Ensure all the relevant fields are chosen when Pend Case type is selected
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false && ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Pend Case') && RecordType.DeveloperName == 'IDR_Task' && (ISBLANK(IDR_Key_Contact_Name__c) || ISPICKVAL(IDR_Pended_To__c,'') || ISPICKVAL(IDR_Pend_Reason__c, '') || ISBLANK(ActivityDate))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Key Contact Name, Pended To, Pend Reason and Due date fields are mandatory for a pend case task.
